text:
sara_fin: FYI — Silverforge was billed the full monthly premium-sla addon on invoice SF-3337 even though addon was activated mid-cycle (should be prorated). Customer is asking for a refund. Need approval to issue manual credit and corrected invoice.

harry_billing: Can you paste the invoice snippet and the prorate math?

sara_fin: Pasted redacted lines: 

```
Invoice SF-3337
Date: 2024-09-05
Line 2: Premium-SLA add-on (monthly) = $12,000
Activation: 2024-09-02 (billing cycle started 2024-09-01)
Should be prorated: (days active 29 of 30) ??? -> actually activated AFTER cycle start, active days = 29? Wait wrong math. Correct: activated 2024-09-02 so charged full month incorrectly.
Expected prorated charge for remainder of month (Sept 2-30) = $11,600 (example) — net overcharge to refund = $400
```

sara_fin: (correction) Sorry messy paste. Clear math below: billing cycle 9/1-9/30, addon price $12k/month. Activated 9/03 (day 3). Days charged should be 28/30 => prorated charge = $11,200. Overcharge = $800. Customer requested refund of $800 + corrected invoice.

mina_am: Silverforge flagged this with AM today. They expect a clean corrected invoice for auditors. Also they mentioned the onboarding flow toggled addon by default; they want assurance it won't happen again.

eng-bot: Detected onboarding-script bug: default_sla_flag true for accounts created via partner-import flow between 2024-09-01 and 2024-09-04. Patch PR #548 opened to change default to false and add unit test. Canary deploy scheduled.

billing-bot: Heuristic: addon-misapply detected (confidence 81%). Suggested actions: 1) issue credit memo CM-SF-202409-CORR amount $800, 2) create corrected invoice INV-SF-3337-CORR, 3) notify customer and attach docs.

harry_billing: Approve manual credit $800 and corrected invoice. Post credit memo and mark ledger with reason = addon_misapply_onboarding.

sara_fin: Approved. I'll post CM-SF-202409-CORR now and attach corrected invoice. Also logging recovery ticket FIN-2024-981 to reconcile if any other partner-import accounts affected.

mina_am: I'll send customer note: "We discovered an internal onboarding misconfiguration that caused the premium SLA to be billed at full month. We've posted a one-time credit of $800 and attached the corrected invoice for your records. We're fixing the onboarding flow and will follow up with assurance." Will paste copy to FIN ticket for sign-off.

eng-bot: Patch merged and canary deployed. Added alert ONBOARD-DEFAULT-SLA when new account created with default_sla_flag=true for partner-import path. Runbook attached to PR.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-SF-202409-CORR posted. Corrected invoice INV-SF-3337-CORR generated and uploaded to customer portal. FIN-2024-981 opened to sweep affected accounts.

harry_billing: Thanks. Please attach ledger export to FIN-2024-981 and close once reconciliation complete.

sara_fin: Will do. Closing loop here — credit posted, invoice corrected, patch deployed, ticket opened. Reopen if customer needs anything else. :white_check_mark:
